_comment: All dimensions in mm. Rotating magnetic bezel — two stacked rings with magnets in edge slots.
_magnet_diameter: Diameter of the cylindrical disc magnets.
_magnet_clearance: Extra width added to slot for fit. Z is snug (floor + ceiling clamp it).
_ring_height: Total height of one ring: magnet_floor + magnet_height + magnet_floor.
_magnet_floor: Wall thickness above and below each magnet slot (ceiling and floor).
_slot_depth: Radial depth of magnet slot into the wall (open on outer rim).
_bezel_extra_height: Extra material added on top of one ring for engraved digit face.
_text_engrave_depth: How deep the digits are cut into the top face.
